authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-111 separate-compatibility-windows design contract: the closed surface list for this closure, the six cells per admitted surface, the meaning of migrations/bridges so they cannot authorize provider-frame translation, and the explicit deferral of the evidence/custody/replay-formats matrix with DR-113 (DR202-RR-F3, ADVISORY, STANDS-AS-ROUTED). It applies nothing, does not fill numeric windows, does not self-admit extra rows, does not evaluate versionConstraint in DR-103 locks, does not make any lock producible by itself (DR-103 lock production still waits on this row closing AND a later DR-103 successor that consumes the windows), and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-111 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-111 a T2-02 candidate that extracts the eight-surface / six-cell schema, scopes slice 1 honestly, refuses to treat 'bridges' as frame translation, and PROPOSES that no DR-103 lock of any form is producible until this row closes with evaluable windows. That full-width rule is THIS artifact's proposed meaning, not a holding of the D-013-accepted component-manifest-schemas.v2 (which states only that no lock over a constrained request is producible). Unaccepted schema successors may already write the wider rule; citing them does not accept them.

linesVerbatim: There is no shared `N/N-1/N-2` promise and no common version number. DR-111 must
set a separate read/write/migration/refusal matrix for each surface:
Each matrix declares current writer, supported readers, migrations/bridges,
future-major refusal, downgrade/no-return, and test evidence. A bundle selects
compatible independent releases; it cannot force same-version coupling.
Resolution is deterministic over the exact signed snapshot, lock constraints,
platform, requested profile, capabilities, compatibility matrices, pins/holds,
and policy. Candidate ordering and tie-breaks are canonical; cycles/conflicts
refuse. The concrete solver/lock encoding remains DR-103/107.

noSharedVersion: There is no shared N/N-1/N-2 promise and no common version number. A bundle cannot force same-version coupling.
bridgesMean: A bridge is a declared, versioned reader or writer adapter owned by the surface's matrix. It MUST NOT wrap, translate, normalize, reorder, reinterpret, merge, or assign new fates to semantic frames of an existing provider protocol (file 02 must-not; D-015 T-3). A 'bridge' that authors provider meaning is a failed successor.

numericWindows: RESERVED. This artifact does not mint how long a reader is supported. Product/versioning sets numbers later. Alias-window numbers are D-012's, not this row's.
lockJoin: THIS ARTIFACT PROPOSES: no lock of any form — exact-pin or constrained, one component or many — is producible until this row closes with evaluable windows, because DR-103 resolutionInputs include hostCoreVersion/platform, compatibility values are owned here, versionConstraint evaluation is owned here, and the lock closure rule requires those evaluations. An exact-pin of one or many admitted tuples is a custody copy, not a completed compatible resolution, and is not a lock. ATTRIBUTION: the D-013-accepted component-manifest-schemas.v2 (73114dde…) states only the narrower rule that no lock over a constrained request is producible; exact-pin is not a request form in that accepted document. The widening to exact-pin and to cardinality is proposed here and is also written in unaccepted schema successors (v6 51b0a0b7… / v7 a8870018…); citing those successors does not accept them and does not lend D-013's acceptance to the wider rule. This artifact does not itself emit a lock or a lock evaluator; it supplies the window/compatibility meaning a later DR-103 successor would consume.
